metadata.description: Self-hosted marketplace for dev-playbook: a team's coding standards, served to coding agents.

plugins.name: dev-playbook
plugins.description: Your team's coding standards, in context. Connects over MCP to a dev-playbook server (run it locally with Docker) for guardrails, definition of done, per-language rules and task workflows - and scaffolds them for a repo that has none. Run /dev-playbook-init to set it up.
